faq.question: What is the Frame Extractor?
faq.answer: The Frame Extractor allows you to manipulate and process media files entirely in your browser.

faq.question: Are my files uploaded to your server?
faq.answer: No. This tool utilizes advanced FFmpeg WebAssembly technology to process your files locally on your device.

faq.question: Why is the processing not starting?
faq.answer: If the tool is in 'Future Ready' mode, it means the server requires specific Cross-Origin headers to enable WebAssembly. This will be activated soon.
